oracle.binary_source_attestation: source hashes verified; binary fingerprint recorded; no embedded commit attestation
oracle.engine: ctypes calls exported GGML C dequantize_row_*; native memmove for F32

sampling: first/middle/last tensor per format; first/middle/last row and outer slice; first/middle/last block plus a two-block boundary window
scope: sampled real trained rows, blocks and expert offsets; not end-to-end model parity
shard_hash_policy: hash sampled raw ranges and manifest only; full shard hashes are not reverified by this run
